moc_hoi: must show the Guildhall (Gothic front); no modern building
canh: the Guildhall roof burning, night of 29 December 1940
loi_cau: Next to St Paul's, the booksellers' street, Paternoster Row, burns — and with it as many as five million books. Fire crews and volunteers of the St Paul's Watch fight the bombs that land on the cathedral itself. Across the City, the Guildhall's roof burns, and nineteen churches are destroyed.
mo_ta: Canh quay tai hien vu chay mai Guildhall trong tran oanh tac London nam 1940 phu hop voi boi canh lich su.
